claude-opus-5-5.note: A charming, polished camelid with a fleecy body, long neck and woven saddle blanket, plus plausible gait changes across frames and a tasteful layered Andean plate; the long banana ears and bare, deer-thin legs read more llama than alpaca, and the walk is believable but somewhat stiff.

openai-gpt-6-sol.note: The alpaca is recognizable and the Altiplano scene is beautifully composed, though its slender legs move more convincingly than its nearly static body.
